topic: 数据比较与图表描述入门
grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。
title: Data Comparison and Chart Description: Advantages of Data-Literacy Training for University Students
prompt: In many universities, students are now encouraged to take courses in data literacy—learning how to read, compare and interpret tables, graphs and survey results. Some educators argue that every undergraduate should receive this training, while others believe it is only useful for students in scientific or business fields. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, explain which advantages of compulsory data-literacy training you consider most important, and state clearly whether you think such courses should be required for all students or only for some. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作 Task 2 练习题，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，确认需要讨论的两种观点，并在文中明确表达自己的立场。建议用约 40 分钟完成，写前花 5 分钟构思：第一段改写题目并给出立场；主体段分别讨论“所有学生必修”和“仅部分专业需要”的理由，可结合数据比较与图表解读能力在日常生活、就业和公共讨论中的作用；结尾段重申观点。注意不要只罗列数据或描述图表，而要围绕 advantages 展开论证，并用具体例子支持。写完后检查字数是否达到 250 词、论点是否清晰、连接词是否恰当。
